instruction_lines_for_manual_review.original: - Take the graph [measurements](#measurements) supplied by the caller and check the proposed diagrams.
Provide the [brief path](#brief-path) and any [missing context](#missing-context). The caller resolves gaps before dispatch.

Provide the completion result in [Delivery State](#delivery-state), identifying remaining blockers. Passing normal delivery checks supplies the caller's closure evidence; the tracker issue's current Development-link gate still governs the write.
- Provide [Review Result](#review-result) with the evidenced threats and gaps to the requesting goal review.

Provide the [hot-fix number](#hot-fix-number) to the caller for rewriting and saving the issue's body, title and labels. The caller then invokes Apply [Settle Hot-fix Board Status](#settle-hot-fix-board-status "ƒ") as its [placement](placement.md#disposition-conditions) orders.
- Provide an abandoned or incorrect Development link to the caller for the user's decision on its removal. A replacement pull request does not remove the requirement on a link still present.
- An empty collection means none of the named issues is closed; provide nothing listed.
Provide [Placement Result](#placement-result) for the requester to offer and apply.
- Use the source issue as the destination with disposition Kept. The caller rewrites its hot-fix body and keeps the issue open.
- Use the source issue as the destination with disposition Leave. The caller rewrites its standalone body and keeps the issue open.

Provide [Placement Result](#placement-result) with the saved destination, identities of all affected bodies and confirmed disposition, including the destination initiative, epic and new row id for a new task or new epic, and the number for a hot-fix. The requester performs the rewrite or closure.
Provide the [complete body file](#output-body) and any [unresolved evidence](#unresolved-evidence) links to the caller for publication.
Run [Submit Epic Merge](#submit-epic-merge "ƒ") with the exact head whose checks and target requirements were verified; provide a refusal without continuing.

Provide [Head Checks](#head-checks) and [Head Status](#head-status), retaining missing or pending evidence as unresolved [Failure](#failure). The requester compares them with supplied target requirements and current reviews.
- On a finding, provide it to the caller; the [pull request](#identity) stays a draft.

literal_values_preserved.literal:
`markdown
- **R1.** [Architecture Overview](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/tree/engineering/artifacts/planning/2026-10-08-950-queue-placement/architecture-overview.md) — the change's structure, its flows, and the order to read the diff.
`

matched_instructions.original: - The diagrams must meet [Measured Structure](#measured-structure) and [Diagrams](#diagrams).
- Populate the overview from the [Template](#template) at the destination in [Overview File](#overview-file).
- All populated fields must meet [Fields](#fields).
- Pin each code reference to the [Pull Request Head](#pull-request-head).
- Each reference must meet [Code References](#code-references).
Provide the completed [Overview File](#overview-file) for registration in its planning record.
- Read the issues, the board and its delivery records.
- Apply [Read Tracker Issue](issue.md#read-tracker-issue "ƒ") for the [Saved Identities](#saved-identities).
- Apply [Read Board State](board.md#read-board-state "ƒ") for the selected board.
- Apply [Fetch All Delivery Pull Requests](pull-request.md#fetch-all-delivery-pull-requests "ƒ") for its repositories and items.
- Apply [Fetch Pull Request Issue Links](pull-request.md#fetch-pull-request-issue-links "ƒ") for those records.
- Fetch the published agent review records linked from each open epic integration pull request, retaining absent or unreadable evidence as a handoff blocker.
- Apply [Read Board Configuration](board.md#read-board-configuration "ƒ").
- Run [Find User](board.md#find-user "ƒ").
- Retain these provided snapshots for the following computation.
- Run [Compute Board Changes](#compute-board-changes "ƒ") to the captured evidence.
- Fetch each unresolved issue.
- Run [Compute Board Changes](#compute-board-changes "ƒ") again, adding the fetched off-board issue records to the retained evidence.
- Run each emitted call, including the assignee calls, which act on the issue rather than the board item.
- Apply [Read Board Configuration](board.md#read-board-configuration "ƒ") for each changed item to confirm its current status.
- If that item still shows the preceding status:
- Repeat its emitted write call.
- Apply [Read Board Configuration](board.md#read-board-configuration "ƒ") again for the same item. The item list can lag a write.
- Fetch the issues and items again.
- Refresh the pull request metadata and linked published agent review records before recomputing statuses; either tip may have changed during the writes.
- Run [Compute Board Changes](#compute-board-changes "ƒ") to the refreshed evidence, retaining every resolved off-board issue record.
- Stop when it emits no further call and every changed item has been confirmed. An issue added in one pass gets its status in the next.
Provide [Confirmed Statuses](#confirmed-statuses) after every changed item has been confirmed, retaining any unresolved discrepancy.

When [Selected Kind](#selected-kind) is proposals and no open board under [Board Owner](#board-owner) has the [proposals title](../configuration.md#proposals-board), Apply [Create Proposals Board](#create-proposals-board "ƒ"). The copy source and the title meet [Proposals](#proposals).
- When the selected theme board is absent:
- Require the new theme's label and board before an initiative takes that theme.
Provide the [Copied Board](#copied-board) after the selected creation path succeeds.
Require the originating proposal record in [Theme Provenance](#theme-provenance) for a proposal-derived board; provide a missing-input finding when its designator is unavailable.
Run [Find Board Template](#find-board-template "ƒ") under [Board Owner](#board-owner) with the exact [theme-template title](../configuration.md#theme-boards).
Use the provided number as the copy source.
Run [Copy Board Template](#copy-board-template "ƒ") with that template number, the owner and the title required by [One Board Per Theme](#one-board-per-theme).
Retain the new board number. The copy carries the [theme-board fields](../configuration.md#theme-boards).
Run [Link Board to Repository](#link-board-to-repository "ƒ") with the owner, new board number and [repository](#repository).
Provide the [Copied Board](#copied-board) after linking succeeds.

Run [Find Proposals Board](#find-proposals-board "ƒ") under [Board Owner](#board-owner) when [Board Selection](#board-selection) names proposals, or Run [Find Theme Board](#find-theme-board "ƒ") for its theme.
Provide the [Selected Board](#selected-board) or an absent-board finding for the requester’s selection or creation path.
Require confirmed [Prerequisite Evidence](#prerequisite-evidence) and a missing destination for [Epic-Base Name](#epic-base-name). Refuse a destination that already exists.
Run [Fetch Remote Branch](#fetch-remote-branch "ƒ") in the [project checkout](#project-checkout) with the corresponding long-lived [source branch](#source-branch), such as `main`.
- After a successful fetch:
- Run [Publish Epic Base](#publish-epic-base "ƒ") in the project checkout with that remote source and the missing epic base name, such as `i07/e00/main`, meeting [Epic Bases](#epic-bases).
- Provide [Branch Result](#branch-result) with the created branch, or [Failure](#failure).
Require [Prerequisite Evidence](#prerequisite-evidence) and names meeting [Task Branches](#task-branches).
Run [Fetch Remote Branch](#fetch-remote-branch "ƒ") in the [project checkout](#project-checkout) of the repository the work changes, passing the base; stop on failure.
Run [Add Task Worktree](#add-task-worktree "ƒ") in the project checkout at [Worktree Path](#worktree-path) for the [task branch](#task-branch), rooted in the fetched [Base Branch](#base-branch).
- Provide [Worktree Result](#worktree-result) with the worktree path, branch and base, or [Failure](#failure).
- A unit that changes several long-lived branches runs this once for each epic base, with the branch and worktree [Task Branches](#task-branches) names for it.
Run [Fetch Branch Protection](#fetch-branch-protection "ƒ") for [Target Branch](#target-branch) in [Repository](#repository), using [Output Files](#output-files) for the evidence destinations.
Run [Fetch Active Branch Rules](#fetch-active-branch-rules "ƒ") for the same target.
Provide [Target Requirements](#target-requirements) with both records, or [Failure](#failure) when a requirement is unreadable. A protection 404 does not establish the absence of active rules.

- Write the [Work Identity](#work-identity) and [Planning Record](#planning-record) context, [Validation Scope](#validation-scope), [Change Autonomy](#change-autonomy) and [Execution Instructions](#execution-instructions) into the prompt file at [Output Path](#output-path) or where [Location](#location) puts it.
- Each part must meet [Fields](#fields).
Apply [Check Epic Readiness](#check-epic-readiness "ƒ") against current delivery and verification evidence.
Reconcile the expected bases with the task delivery targets.

Confirm from [Base Merges](#base-merges) that every base has merged into its corresponding long-lived branch. An unknown or incomplete base list, or missing merge evidence, leaves completion unconfirmed even when every task is delivered and every criterion is ticked.
Check for anything outside [Plan Bodies](#plan-bodies) that reads, builds or ships the [Changed Surface](#changed-surface).
Check for a skip, a fallback, or a fail-closed path that hides a violation.
Check that done has a threshold, a baseline, and an instrument that is independent of the thing measured. The baseline is fixed before the plan changes what it measures.
Check for skew between an artifact the plan produces and an implementation that reads it.
- Check for a change elsewhere that alters the ground the plan stands on.
- Populate the standalone [Template](standalone-body.md#template) for [Hot-fix Identity](#hot-fix-identity) at the destination in [Output Body](#output-body).
- The work must meet [Definition](#definition).
- The title must meet the shared [Titles](issue-body.md#titles) conditions and the hot-fix [Titles](#titles).
- Name the confirmed [Target](#target) in the Overview.
- Populate the Problem and Proposal from [Defect Evidence](#defect-evidence), meeting [Problem and Proposal](issue-body.md#problem-and-proposal).
- All populated fields must meet [Fields](#fields).
Provide the populated [Output Body](#output-body) for publication.

Apply [Select Tracker Number](issue.md#select-tracker-number "ƒ") in [Repository](#repository) using the hot-fix prefix letter to select a number for the source issue identified by [Hot-fix Identity](#hot-fix-identity).
Apply [Ensure Repository Labels](repository-labels.md#ensure-repository-labels "ƒ") with the labels hot-fix [Titles](hotfix-body.md#titles) name.

Apply [Record Dispatch Status](board-delivery.md#record-dispatch-status "ƒ") with [Hot-fix Identity](#hot-fix-identity) for In Progress and the supplied [Board Evidence](#board-evidence). That status is the hold [Delivery Unit](#delivery-unit) defines.
Provide [Board Result](#board-result) with the confirmed status or discrepancy. The session starts only once it is confirmed.
- Apply [Capture Issue Development](issue.md#capture-issue-development "ƒ") for [Hot-fix Identity](#hot-fix-identity).
- Refuse the release while its [Delivery Unit](#delivery-unit) is running or unrecorded, and provide the pull request that makes it so to the caller.
Apply [Place Issue on Board](board.md#place-issue-on-board "ƒ") with the board in [Board Evidence](#board-evidence), the hot-fix issue and Ready.
Provide [Board Result](#board-result) with the saved item and Status.
Read each local source in [Requirement References](#requirement-references) at its checkout path, retaining any supplied [Source Evidence](#source-evidence).
For a pinned GitHub blob, Run [Fetch Source](#fetch-source "ƒ") with its repository, path and pinned revision, saving it at [Output Files](#output-files).
Fetch other URLs through the harness's web access.
Record an unreadable or empty source as a [Sources](#sources) finding; its criteria remain unevaluated.
Provide [Source Evidence](#source-evidence) with each source’s contents and identity, and [Validation Findings](#validation-findings) for unreadable or empty sources.

Evaluate [Initiative Record](#initiative-record), [Epic Records](#epic-records), [Verification Evidence](#verification-evidence) and [Development Evidence](#development-evidence) against [Delivery State](#delivery-state).

Identify each missing, open or cancelled epic, each unverified or unticked criterion, and each unmerged or unreadable Development-linked pull request. Incomplete link evidence leaves completion unconfirmed.

Provide the completion result and its supporting issue identities, evidence revisions and blockers. Passing normal delivery checks supplies the caller's closure evidence; the tracker issue's current Development-link gate still governs the write.
Run [List Reference Repositories](#list-reference-repositories "ƒ") to [Body Record](#body-record) to identify the destination and cited repositories.

Run [Fetch Reference Repository](#fetch-reference-repository "ƒ") for each provided name; collect the objects into a JSON array at the snapshot path in [Output Files](#output-files). Retain failed fetches as unresolved visibility, never as public visibility.
Run [Validate Reference Visibility](#validate-reference-visibility "ƒ") with that snapshot and the issue record.

Provide [Visibility Findings](#visibility-findings) identifying each private reference on a public issue and each unavailable visibility. A private destination has no public-reference restriction; deciding how to replace or remove a private reference belongs to the requester.
- Apply [Capture Issue Development](#capture-issue-development "ƒ") for the issue in [Identity](#identity), saving its current JSON and Development snapshot to [Output Files](#output-files).

- The issue's entire Development field establishes membership, across repositories and states. Titles, branch names, body mentions and a list filtered to one initiative do not. An empty field adds no [pull request](#identity) requirement.
Run [Check Issue Closure](#check-issue-closure "ƒ") with those two files.
- Require the normal delivery checks in [Delivery Evidence](#delivery-evidence) to pass, every criterion to be verified and ticked, and every currently linked pull request to be merged.
- Keep the issue open for an open, draft or closed-without-merge linked pull request, and for links never read.
Provide the confirmed [State](#state) or [Closure Findings](#closure-findings) identifying the closure blocker.
Confirm [Transfer Evidence](#transfer-evidence) establishes that the destination contains the work and cites the source issue in [Identity](#identity).
Apply [Comment on Issue](#comment-on-issue "ƒ") with the destination reference and [Comment](#comment).
Run [Close as Not Planned](#close-as-not-planned "ƒ"), retaining the issue's body.
Run [Fetch Tracker Issue](#fetch-tracker-issue "ƒ") to confirm its state and reason.
Provide the confirmed [State](#state) and reason after the saved issue is read back.
Apply [Capture Issue Development](#capture-issue-development "ƒ") immediately before closure.
Run [Check Issue Closure](#check-issue-closure "ƒ") with the issue and Development files it wrote, using absolute evidence paths when changing directory.
Require exit 0 and passing normal checks from [Delivery Evidence](#delivery-evidence); a sync report of closable does not permit skipping this gate.
Immediately after the gate passes, Run [Set Completed State](#set-completed-state "ƒ") with the issue's [repository](#repository) and number and the passing evidence.
Provide the saved [State](#state) or [Closure Findings](#closure-findings) with the failure.
- Fetch only the closed issues in [Audit Selection](#audit-selection) using [Authenticated Access](#authenticated-access), saving evidence to [Output Files](#output-files):
- For named issues, Run [Fetch Selected Closed Issues](#fetch-selected-closed-issues "ƒ") with their numbers.
- For the whole [repository](#repository), Run [Fetch Closed Issues](#fetch-closed-issues "ƒ").
Run [Capture Issue Links](#capture-issue-links "ƒ") with that collection; an unreadable relation is provided as a blocker and the sweep does not run.
Run [Sweep Closure Evidence](#sweep-closure-evidence "ƒ") with the collection and the issue-links file.

Provide [Closure Findings](#closure-findings) with each unsupported issue’s state reason and findings, and each unevaluable issue as missing evidence. List not-planned closures separately for reference. The audit changes no issue.
- Identify an existing task, a new task, a new epic, a new initiative, a hot-fix, or Leave for the orphan and candidate destinations in [Placement Inputs](#placement-inputs).

- Offer a hot-fix only for an orphan that meets the hot-fix [Definition](hotfix-body.md#definition), with the theme board it joins and its [target](hotfix-body.md#target): the declared long-lived branch the orphan's evidence places the defect on, the repository's default branch where it is declared and the evidence names no other.
Populate the placement meeting [Fields](#fields) and [Disposition Conditions](#disposition-conditions).
- Execute only the branch matching [Confirmed Placement](#confirmed-placement):
- Add the orphan's outcomes to the task criteria.
- Add its design to Proposal.
- When they exceed the epic's criteria, add epic criteria cited by the task row.
- Apply [Save Tracker Issue](issue.md#save-tracker-issue "ƒ") with the affected bodies.
- Apply [Populate Epic Issue Body](epic-issue-body.md#populate-epic-issue-body "ƒ") with the confirmed task scope, current epic context and output path.
- Add the epic criteria the row's Coverage needs where the orphan's outcomes exceed the epic's, as [Destination Work](#destination-work) states.
- Leave the row's Task cell holding the row id alone until the work is planned and the row gains its work-item file, as [Task Delivery](epic-issue-body.md#task-delivery) states.
- Number the row where it can start, and keep its row id for the result.

- When movable rows change number, Apply [Check Dependencies and Numbering](dependency-graph.md#check-dependencies-and-numbering "ƒ") with the affected initiative and epic drafts and confirmed numbering map.
- Apply [Save Tracker Issue](issue.md#save-tracker-issue "ƒ") with the checked bodies.
- Apply [Populate Epic Issue Body](epic-issue-body.md#populate-epic-issue-body "ƒ"), carrying the orphan's work in a task row, and keep its row id for the result.
- Apply [Draft Initiative Issue Body](initiative-issue-body.md#draft-initiative-issue-body "ƒ") with the covering row.
- Apply [Save Tracker Issue](issue.md#save-tracker-issue "ƒ") with the epic.
- Link its issue in the initiative row.
- Apply [Populate Initiative Issue Body](initiative-issue-body.md#populate-initiative-issue-body "ƒ") from the orphan's scoped problem and confirmed goal.
- Apply [Save Tracker Issue](issue.md#save-tracker-issue "ƒ") with the populated initiative body.
- Carry evidence into Problem and design into Proposal.
- Pass a hot-fix its supplied number, theme label and target.
- Apply [Check Round of Edits](issue-body.md#check-round-of-edits "ƒ") with the populated body and selected kind conditions before publishing.
- Resolve findings.
- Apply [Save Tracker Issue](issue.md#save-tracker-issue "ƒ") with the validated body, title and labels, a hot-fix's being every label its [Titles](hotfix-body.md#titles) name.
For a hot-fix, Apply [Settle Hot-fix Board Status](hotfix.md#settle-hot-fix-board-status "ƒ") with the confirmed theme board and the saved issue.
Provide [Saved Orphan](#saved-orphan) with the saved identity and a hot-fix’s settled board item.
- Transfer the work in [Transfer Inputs](#transfer-inputs) to the taking issue.
- Make each outcome a criterion of one invariant.
- Put the design in Proposal.
- Cite the orphan and any planning record in References.
Prepare the comment file naming the taking epic and row, or the taking task issue, for example `Tracked in [I07:E01](…/issues/937) W04.` The closure operation records it once.
- Provide [Saved Orphan](#saved-orphan) with the confirmed closure or blocker.
- Populate the [Template](#template) from [Proposal Context](#proposal-context) at the destination in [Output Body](#output-body).
- The title must meet the shared [Titles](issue-body.md#titles) conditions and the proposal [Titles](#titles).
- The Problem must meet the shared [Problem and Proposal](issue-body.md#problem-and-proposal) conditions.
- All populated fields must meet [Fields](#fields).
Provide the populated [Output Body](#output-body) for publication.

- Populate the [Template](#template) from [Change Evidence](#change-evidence), retaining applicable content in [Current Body](#current-body) and writing to [Output Body](#output-body). For an epic review, Apply [Populate Review Body](#populate-review-body "ƒ").
- All populated fields must meet [Fields](#fields).
Verify each result link against [Test Plan](#test-plan) before publishing the body.

Add [Overview URL](#overview-url) as the Architecture Overview reference in the References of [Current Body](#current-body), creating that section in its [Template](#template) position when absent and writing to [Output Body](#output-body).
Preserve an existing row already naming the overview. The link uses the engineering-artifacts base URL so later files resolve from the same record.
Provide the complete [updated body](#output-body) file for publication.
Require the supplied [Target Requirements](#target-requirements), [Readiness Evidence](#readiness-evidence) and [Merge Authorization](#merge-authorization).
Run [Read Merge Result](#read-merge-result "ƒ") for that [pull request](#identity).
Confirm the merged state, merge commit, [verified head](#verified-head) and target.
Provide [Merge Result](#merge-result) or [Failure](#failure) with the discrepancy.
Run [Fetch Head Check Runs](#fetch-head-check-runs "ƒ") for the verified head.
Run [Fetch Head Status](#fetch-head-status "ƒ") for the same SHA.
Require [Epic Readiness](#epic-readiness) and Apply [Read Pull Request State](#read-pull-request-state "ƒ") for [Identity](#identity).

Run [Validate Agent Review](agent-review.md#validate-agent-review "ƒ") with the fresh metadata and [Published Reviews](#published-reviews). On a finding, Apply [Hold Epic Review](#hold-epic-review "ƒ") and stop. For a draft with passing evidence, Run [Mark Review Ready](#mark-review-ready "ƒ") with its node id.

Apply [Read Pull Request State](#read-pull-request-state "ƒ") again with the same identity, then Run [Validate Agent Review](agent-review.md#validate-agent-review "ƒ") again with that fresh metadata and the same published records. For a changed revision, Apply [Hold Epic Review](#hold-epic-review "ƒ") and report the discrepancy. Provide [Review State](#review-state) only with current evidence, or [Failure](#failure) for the changed revision or discrepancy. Target review requirements still govern the merge.
Apply [Read Pull Request State](#read-pull-request-state "ƒ") for its full metadata.
- Run [Validate Agent Review](agent-review.md#validate-agent-review "ƒ") with that metadata and [Published Reviews](#published-reviews).
For a draft with passing evidence, Run [Mark Review Ready](#mark-review-ready "ƒ") with the node id its metadata names.

Apply [Read Pull Request State](#read-pull-request-state "ƒ") again with the same identity, then Run [Validate Agent Review](agent-review.md#validate-agent-review "ƒ") again with that fresh metadata and the same published records. Provide [Review State](#review-state), or [Failure](#failure) with the changed revision or finding that leaves it unconfirmed.
Verify the problem against the source in [Finding Evidence](#finding-evidence).
If evidence is missing or contradictory, provide that finding for the caller to resolve.
- Populate the finding with its source quotation.
- It must meet [Finding Content](#finding-content) and [Decision State](#decision-state).
Provide [Finding Result](#finding-result) with the finding and any pending decision.

Apply [Populate Standalone Body](#populate-standalone-body "ƒ") to [Current Body](#current-body) with [Confirmed Boundary](#confirmed-boundary), folding any Non-Goals into Proposal as a closing boundary and writing to [Output Body](#output-body).
Provide the revised [Output Body](#output-body) for publication.
